# Tools

73 tools (72 by default, plus `run_lua` when `ASEPRITE_MCP_ALLOW_LUA=1`). This page is generated from the tool schemas, so it matches what a client sees.

- **batchable**: can be an op in a [`batch`](#batch) call, which runs several of them in one Aseprite process. See [batch](batch.md).
- **read-only**: never changes the sprite file.
- Tools that work on a sprite take `path` first; relative paths resolve against `ASEPRITE_MCP_ROOT`. Inside `batch`, leave `path` out of `args`.

|---|---|

## Sprite

Create, inspect, convert, resize, crop and copy a sprite.

### `create_sprite`

Create a sprite file with one layer and one frame and return its info.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `width` | int 1..4096 | required | Width in pixels |
| `height` | int 1..4096 | required | Height in pixels |
| `color_mode` | rgb / grayscale / indexed | `"rgb"` | Colour mode |
| `background` | string | `null` | Fill colour of the layer; default transparent |
| `overwrite` | bool | `false` | Replace the file if it already exists |

### `get_sprite_info`

Size, color mode, palette size, frames with durations, layer tree, tags and slice count.

batchable · read-only

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |

### `set_color_mode`

Convert the sprite to rgb, grayscale or indexed.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `mode` | rgb / grayscale / indexed | required | Colour mode |

### `resize_sprite`

Scale the whole sprite (every layer and frame) to a new size, nearest-neighbour.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `width` | int 1..4096 | required | Width in pixels |
| `height` | int 1..4096 | required | Height in pixels |

### `crop_sprite`

Crop the canvas to rect in every layer and frame; rect must overlap the canvas.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `rect` | Rect {x, y, w, h} | required | Area to keep, in canvas pixels |

### `save_copy`

Write a copy of the sprite to another file, leaving the source untouched.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `output` | string | required | File to write; relative paths resolve against the root |
| `overwrite` | bool | `false` | Replace the file if it already exists |

## Layers

Layers, groups and tilemap layers.

### `add_layer`

Add a layer, group or tilemap layer on top of its parent's stack.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `name` | string | required | Layer name |
| `kind` | normal / group / tilemap | `"normal"` | What to add |
| `parent` | string | `""` | Group to add the layer to; empty for the top level |
| `tile_size` | int 1..256 | `null` | Tile width and height, tilemap only |

### `update_layer`

Rename, show/hide, lock/unlock, restyle or move a layer; only the given fields change.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `new_name` | string | `null` | New layer name |
| `visible` | bool | `null` | Show or hide the layer |
| `locked` | bool | `null` | Lock or unlock the layer against pixel and cel edits |
| `opacity` | int 0..255 | `null` | Layer opacity, 0..255 |
| `blend_mode` | normal / multiply / screen / overlay / darken / lighten / color_dodge / color_burn / hard_light / soft_light / difference / exclusion / hue / saturation / color / luminosity / addition / subtract / divide | `null` | Layer blend mode |
| `parent` | string | `null` | Group to move the layer into; empty string for the top level |
| `stack_index` | int >= 1 | `null` | Position inside the (new) parent, 1 = bottom |

### `delete_layer`

Delete a layer; deleting a group deletes everything in it.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |

### `duplicate_layer`

Copy a layer (a group with all its children) right above the original.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `new_name` | string | `null` | New layer name |

### `merge_layer_down`

Merge a layer into the one below it in the same group, in every frame.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |

### `flatten_sprite`

Flatten all visible layers into a single layer; hidden layers are dropped.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |

## Frames and tags

Frames, durations and animation tags.

### `add_frames`

Insert frames, empty unless copy_content is true. Returns the new frame numbers.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `count` | int 1..512 | `1` | Frames to add |
| `after` | int >= 0 | `null` | Insert after this frame; 0 inserts at the start, null appends |
| `duration_ms` | int 1..65535 | `null` | Duration of the new frames |
| `copy_content` | bool | `false` | Copy the cels of the frame before the new ones |

### `delete_frames`

Delete frames; later frames and tags move up. At least one frame must remain.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `frames` | string or int | required | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

### `set_frame_duration`

Set how long frames are shown, in milliseconds.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `duration_ms` | int 1..65535 | required | Frame duration in milliseconds |
| `frames` | string or int | `"all"` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

### `copy_frames`

Copy the cels of one frame into other frames, layers inside groups included.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `source` | int >= 1 | required | 1-based frame number |
| `targets` | string or int | required | Frames to copy into ("2", "3-6", "all"), or "append:N" to add N empty frames at the end and copy into those |
| `layers` | string[] (at least 1) | `null` | Layers to copy (a group means all layers in it); null for all |
| `mode` | replace / missing_only | `"replace"` | replace every target cel, or fill only where a layer has none |
| `link` | bool | `false` | Make the copies linked cels |

### `set_tag`

Create a tag over frames from_frame..to_frame, or update the tag with that name.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `name` | string | required | Tag name, matched exactly |
| `from_frame` | int >= 1 | required | 1-based frame number |
| `to_frame` | int >= 1 | required | 1-based frame number |
| `direction` | forward / reverse / pingpong / pingpong_reverse | `"forward"` | Playback direction of the tag |
| `repeat` | int 0..65535 | `0` | Times to play the tag; 0 loops forever |

### `delete_tag`

Delete the tag with this exact name (the first one if several share it).

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `name` | string | required | Tag name, matched exactly |

## Cels

Position, opacity and motion of a layer's cels.

### `set_cel`

Set the position, opacity and/or z-index of a layer's cels in the given frames.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `frames` | string or int | required | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |
| `x` | int -65535..65535 | `null` | Cel left edge in sprite pixels |
| `y` | int -65535..65535 | `null` | Cel top edge in sprite pixels |
| `relative` | bool | `false` | Move by x/y instead of moving to x/y |
| `opacity` | int 0..255 | `null` | Cel opacity, 0..255 |
| `z_index` | int -32768..32767 | `null` | Draw order offset against other layers' cels |
| `create` | bool | `false` | Create an empty cel where the layer has none |

### `clear_cels`

Delete a layer's cels in the given frames; frames without a cel are skipped.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `frames` | string or int | required | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

### `tween_cels`

Animate a layer's cels from start to end across the frames, in frame order.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `frames` | string or int | required | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |
| `property` | position / opacity / scale | required | What to animate |
| `start` | number or XY {x, y} | required | position: {x, y} cel position; opacity: 0..255; scale: a factor or {x, y} factors, 0.05..16 |
| `end` | number or XY {x, y} | required | position: {x, y} cel position; opacity: 0..255; scale: a factor or {x, y} factors, 0.05..16 |
| `easing` | linear / ease_in / ease_out / ease_in_out / ease_out_back / bounce | `"linear"` | How the value moves from start to end |
| `source_frame` | int >= 1 | `null` | scale only: frame whose cel is scaled; default first frame |
| `anchor` | center / bottom / top_left | `"center"` | scale only: point of the cel that stays in place |
| `loop` | bool | `false` | Stop one step before end so a looping animation stays smooth |

### `oscillate_cels`

Swing a layer's cels along a sine wave across the frames (a bob or sway loop).

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `frames` | string or int | required | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |
| `amplitude_x` | number -4096..4096 | `0` | Horizontal swing in pixels |
| `amplitude_y` | number -4096..4096 | `0` | Vertical swing in pixels |
| `cycles` | number 0.1..64 | `1.0` | Full waves across the frames |
| `phase` | number -64..64 | `0.0` | Offset in cycles |

## Drawing

Shapes, fills, gradients, pixel art from text.

### `draw_pixels`

Set individual pixels to exact colours (no blending; a later entry wins).

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `pixels` | Pixel {x, y, color}[] (1..16384 items) | required | Pixels as {x, y, color} |
| `layer` | string | `""` | Layer name or 'group/child' path; empty = the bottom-most normal layer |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame number |
| `create_cel` | bool | `true` | Add an empty cel when the layer has none in that frame |

### `draw_line`

Draw a polyline through the points, clipped to the canvas.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `points` | Point {x, y}[] (2..4096 items) | required | Line vertices as {x, y}, in order |
| `color` | string | required | '#RRGGBB', '#RRGGBBAA' or 'transparent' |
| `thickness` | int 1..64 | `1` | Brush size in pixels |
| `closed` | bool | `false` | Also connect the last point to the first |
| `layer` | string | `""` | Layer name or 'group/child' path; empty = the bottom-most normal layer |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame number |
| `create_cel` | bool | `true` | Add an empty cel when the layer has none in that frame |
| `blend` | bool | `false` | false: pixels get exactly this colour (transparent erases, except on a background layer, which ignores alpha); true: the colour is alpha-blended over what is there. On indexed sprites the result snaps to the nearest palette entry, so a faint colour paints a solid one |

Draw a rectangle outline (growing inwards with thickness) or a filled rectangle.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `color` | string | required | '#RRGGBB', '#RRGGBBAA' or 'transparent' |
| `fill` | bool | `false` | Fill the shape; false draws the outline only |
| `thickness` | int 1..64 | `1` | Outline width inside the rect; ignored with fill |
| `layer` | string | `""` | Layer name or 'group/child' path; empty = the bottom-most normal layer |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame number |
| `create_cel` | bool | `true` | Add an empty cel when the layer has none in that frame |
| `blend` | bool | `false` | false: pixels get exactly this colour (transparent erases, except on a background layer, which ignores alpha); true: the colour is alpha-blended over what is there. On indexed sprites the result snaps to the nearest palette entry, so a faint colour paints a solid one |

| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame number |
| `create_cel` | bool | `true` | Add an empty cel when the layer has none in that frame |
| `blend` | bool | `false` | false: pixels get exactly this colour (transparent erases, except on a background layer, which ignores alpha); true: the colour is alpha-blended over what is there. On indexed sprites the result snaps to the nearest palette entry, so a faint colour paints a solid one |

## Text

Fonts and text, including Aseprite's own pixel fonts.

### `list_fonts`

List installed fonts usable as draw_text's font, sorted by name.

read-only

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | `null` | Only fonts whose name or file name contains this |
| `limit` | int 1..1000 | `100` | Most fonts to list |

### `measure_text`

Size in pixels that draw_text would paint for this text, without a sprite.

read-only

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | required | Text, at most 2000 characters; '\n' starts a new line |
| `font` | string | `null` | Font name from list_fonts (family, 'Family Style' or file name, any case) or an absolute path to a .ttf/.otf/.ttc file; empty = the built-in font. 'Aseprite' and 'Aseprite Mini' are Aseprite's own pixel fonts |
| `size` | int 1..256 | `16` | Font size in pixels (FreeType pixel size); bitmap fonts ignore it |
| `bold` | bool | `false` | Thicken the glyphs by 1 px to the right |
| `letter_spacing` | int -8..32 | `0` | Extra px between characters |
| `line_spacing` | int -64..256 | `0` | Extra px between lines |
| `outline_width` | int 0..8 | `0` | Outline thickness; 0 for none |
| `shadow_dx` | int -16..16 | `0` | Shadow offset to the right |
| `shadow_dy` | int -16..16 | `0` | Shadow offset downwards |

### `draw_text`

Render text with a font and paint it onto a layer.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `text` | string | required | Text, at most 2000 characters; '\n' starts a new line |
| `x` | int -65535..65535 | required | Canvas x of the anchor point |
| `y` | int -65535..65535 | required | Canvas y of the anchor point |
| `color` | string | required | '#RRGGBB', '#RRGGBBAA' or 'transparent' |
| `font` | string | `null` | Font name from list_fonts (family, 'Family Style' or file name, any case) or an absolute path to a .ttf/.otf/.ttc file; empty = the built-in font. 'Aseprite' and 'Aseprite Mini' are Aseprite's own pixel fonts |
| `size` | int 1..256 | `16` | Font size in pixels (FreeType pixel size); bitmap fonts ignore it |
| `anchor` | top_left / top / top_right / left / center / right / bottom_left / bottom / bottom_right | `"top_left"` | Which pixel of the text's bounding box lands on (x, y) |
| `bold` | bool | `false` | Thicken the glyphs by 1 px to the right |
| `antialias` | bool | `false` | Keep smooth, partly transparent glyph edges; false = crisp pixels |
| `outline` | string | `null` | Colour of a ring around the glyphs |
| `outline_width` | int 1..8 | `1` | Outline thickness in pixels |
| `shadow` | string | `null` | Colour of a drop shadow |
| `shadow_dx` | int -16..16 | `1` | Shadow offset to the right |
| `shadow_dy` | int -16..16 | `1` | Shadow offset downwards |
| `letter_spacing` | int -8..32 | `0` | Extra px between characters |
| `line_spacing` | int -64..256 | `0` | Extra px between lines |
| `layer` | string | `""` | Layer name or 'group/child' path; empty = the bottom-most normal layer |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame number |
| `create_cel` | bool | `true` | Add an empty cel when the layer has none in that frame |
| `blend` | bool | `false` | false: pixels get exactly this colour (transparent erases, except on a background layer, which ignores alpha); true: the colour is alpha-blended over what is there. On indexed sprites the result snaps to the nearest palette entry, so a faint colour paints a solid one |

## Regions and transforms

Move, erase, flip and rotate.

### `move_region`

Move (or with copy, duplicate) the pixels of a layer inside rect by (dx, dy).

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `rect` | Rect {x, y, w, h} | required | Canvas rectangle to move |
| `dx` | int -65535..65535 | required | Pixels to move by; negative goes left or up |
| `dy` | int -65535..65535 | required | Pixels to move by; negative goes left or up |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame number |
| `copy` | bool | `false` | Leave the source pixels where they are |
| `target_layer` | string | `null` | Layer to put the pixels on; default the same layer |
| `target_frame` | int >= 1 | `null` | Frame to put the pixels in; default the same frame |
| `blend` | bool | `false` | false: the moved block replaces what is under it, transparent pixels included; true: it is alpha-blended over it |

### `erase_region`

Make the pixels of a layer inside rect transparent in each of the frames.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `rect` | Rect {x, y, w, h} | required | Canvas rectangle to clear |
| `frames` | string or int | `1` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

### `flip`

Mirror a layer, or every layer, across the canvas centre.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `axis` | horizontal / vertical | required | horizontal mirrors left-right, vertical mirrors top-bottom |
| `layer` | string | `null` | Layer name or 'group/child' path; leave out for every layer |
| `frames` | string or int | `"all"` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

### `rotate`

Turn the whole sprite, or one layer, clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `angle` | 90 / 180 / 270 | required | Degrees clockwise |
| `layer` | string | `null` | Layer name or 'group/child' path; leave out for every layer |
| `frames` | string or int | `"all"` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

| `frames` | string or int | `1` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `region` | Rect {x, y, w, h} | `null` | Only change pixels inside this canvas rectangle; default the whole cel |

### `outline`

Draw a one-pixel outline around the non-transparent shapes of a layer.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `color` | string | required | '#RRGGBB', '#RRGGBBAA' or 'transparent' |
| `frames` | string or int | `1` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |

| `region` | Rect {x, y, w, h} | `null` | Only change pixels inside this canvas rectangle; default the whole cel |

| `frames` | string or int | `1` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |
| `region` | Rect {x, y, w, h} | `null` | Only change pixels inside this canvas rectangle; default the whole cel |

## Animation checks

Audit and repair animations, copy layers between sprites.

### `check_animation`

Audit the animation without changing it; every layer is checked, nested ones too.

batchable · read-only

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `frames` | string or int | `"all"` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |
| `required_layers` | string[] (up to 256) | `null` | Layers that must exist |
| `layer_frame_ranges` | object | `null` | Layer name or path -> the frames it may have pixels in, e.g. {"Sword": "3-5"}; a group covers all its layers |
| `overlap_pairs` | [string, string][] (up to 256) | `null` | Layer pairs whose pixels must not overlap |

### `repair_animation`

Fix the structure of an animation; everything is checked before anything changes.

batchable

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `frames` | string or int | `"all"` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all" (1-based) |
| `ensure_layers` | string[] (up to 256) | `null` | Layers to create when missing; 'group/name' creates it in that group |
| `layer_order` | string[] (up to 256) | `null` | Sibling layers in the wanted order, bottom first |
| `layer_frame_ranges` | object | `null` | Layer name or path -> the frames it may have pixels in, e.g. {"Sword": "3-5"}; a group covers all its layers |
| `out_of_range` | report / hide / delete | `"report"` | What to do with cels outside a layer's frame range |

Copy layers from another sprite into the target, on top of its top level.

batchable

| `layers` | string[] (1..256 items) | required | Source layers or groups |
| `replace` | bool | `false` | Replace a top-level target layer with the same name |

## Export and import

Images, sprite sheets, per-layer PNGs, import, preview.

### `export`

Render the sprite to .png, .gif, .webp, .bmp, .tga or .qoi; the sprite is not changed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `output` | string | required | Image file to write; the extension picks the format |
| `frames` | string or int | `null` | Frames: a number, "1-4", "1-4,7" or "all"; default see below |
| `tag` | string | `null` | Export this tag's frames |
| `layer` | string | `null` | Export only this layer or group, shown alone |
| `scale` | int 1..32 | `1` | Output pixels per sprite pixel (nearest) |
| `background` | string | `null` | Colour behind transparent pixels; default none |
| `overwrite` | bool | `false` | Replace files that already exist |

### `export_spritesheet`

Lay the frames out in one image with Aseprite's sprite sheet exporter.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `output` | string | required | Sheet image: .png, .bmp, .tga or .qoi |
| `data_output` | string | `null` | JSON file describing the frames; default none |
| `sheet_type` | horizontal / vertical / rows / columns / packed | `"horizontal"` | Layout: one row, one column, a grid filled by rows or columns, or packed |
| `tag` | string | `null` | Only this tag's frames |
| `scale` | int 1..32 | `1` | Output pixels per sprite pixel (nearest) |
| `padding` | int 0..32 | `0` | Pixels between frames |
| `data_format` | hash / array | `"hash"` | JSON frames as an object keyed by name, or a list |
| `overwrite` | bool | `false` | Replace files that already exist |

### `export_layers`

Write one canvas-sized PNG per layer of one frame; the sprite is not changed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `output_dir` | string | required | Folder for the PNG files; created when missing |
| `include_hidden` | bool | `false` | Export hidden layers too |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame to export |
| `overwrite` | bool | `false` | Replace files that already exist |

### `import_image`

Draw an image file into a layer at (x, y), over the pixels already there.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `image` | string | required | Image file to draw in (png, gif, bmp, jpg, webp, ...) |
| `layer` | string | required | Layer name, or a 'group/child' path for nested layers |
| `frame` | int >= 1 | `1` | 1-based frame |
| `x` | int -65535..65535 | `0` | Canvas x of the image's left edge |
| `y` | int -65535..65535 | `0` | Canvas y of the image's top edge |

### `start_preview`

Serve a folder over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 so exported images can be opened in a browser.

| `port` | int 0..65535 | `0` | 0 picks a free port |

|---|---|---|---|

## Other

Batching, drawing guides and the opt-in Lua tool.

### `batch`

Run several single-step tools on one sprite in one go and return their results in order.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Sprite file. Relative paths resolve against the server root. |
| `ops` | BatchItem {tool, args}[] (at least 1) | required | Tools to run, in order, as {tool, args} |

### `pixel_art_guide`

Short practical notes on drawing or animating pixel art with this server's tools.

read-only

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `topic` | basics / animation / idle / walk / attack / effects | `"basics"` | Which notes to show |

### `run_lua`

Run a Lua script with Aseprite's scripting API.

opt-in: needs `ASEPRITE_MCP_ALLOW_LUA=1`, never in sandbox mode

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | string | required | Lua source run inside Aseprite |
| `path` | string | `null` | Sprite to open first; relative paths resolve against the root |
| `save` | bool | `false` | Save the sprite when the script succeeds |
